chapters.title: Berlin Defence
chapters.intro: The Berlin Defence is Black's most solid answer to the Ruy Lopez and a favourite of world champions. White chooses between the forcing main line, where queens often come off early, and calmer protecting setups that keep the pieces on the board.

variations.name: Berlin Defense, Rio Gambit Accepted
variations.intro: Black simply takes the centre pawn after White castles. White regains it by force, and the play splits into the queenless Berlin endgame and the rook-lift lines where White pressures Black's uncastled king along the open file.

chapters.title: Firouzja–Carlsen, Tata Steel 2020
chapters.intro: A modern classical game in the Anti-Berlin: White plays the same calm protection of the centre pawn that this course teaches, and Black chooses a solid closed setup.
